Vasarosnameny Jewish Cemetery 1

Jewish Cemetery · Vásárosnamény, Hungary

Not demolished. One of three Jewish cemeteries in modern Vásárosnamény, established by 1856 with tombstones through 1948. Population grew from 25 (1840) to a peak of 896 by 1941 (of 3,755 total residents), drawing in Jews from surrounding villages under its jurisdiction. Rabbi Elias Kohn, born locally in 1875, led the Orthodox community from 1905 after training as assistant rabbi in Beregszász, holding the community together even through the Holocaust; he and his wife Chaja had 15 children before both were murdered at Auschwitz following the community's 1944 Passover deportation via the Beregszász brick factory.
